history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A young Indonesian male, wearing a black full-face helmet with a prominent chin guard and a blue hooded jacket over a t-shirt, sits casually on a white scooter. He has a backpack with white straps. His light blue pants are slightly wrinkled, and he wears black sneakers with white soles. Another person, partially visible on the left, wears a white shirt and light blue pants, also appearing to be a student. The scooter has a white helmet with red and black accents and some text, resting on its handlebars. The background consists of a rough, grey concrete wall with patches of blue paint, and dry leaves and twigs on the ground. Two grey heart emojis are superimposed on the scooter's body. The lighting is natural daylight, casting subtle shadows and highlighting the textures of the clothing and scooter. The overall mood is relaxed and youthful, with a slightly muted color palette dominated by blues, greys, and white. The image has a slightly grainy, candid feel.
